House Hit By Alleged US Strike During Wedding In Sirik, Iran | Iran US War
A house in Sirik, Iran, was reportedly hit during an alleged U.S. strike while a wedding gathering was taking place, according to Mehr News Agency footage cited by Viory. The reported incident has drawn attention amid continued military tensions between the United States and Iran. Visuals from the scene show damage to the property, while details surrounding the strike, the intended target and possible casualties remain subject to verification. The allegation comes as military operations and retaliatory threats continue to raise fears of further escalation across the region.
